records.region: Northeastern Manitoba, Canada; Kaskattama River region toward Hudson Bay east of Cape Tatnam.

records.region: Western Maranhão, Brazil; selected Maracaçumé corridor toward the Cândido Mendes coastal region.
records.candidate_name_role: Mapped middle/lower river candidate only; not a completed whole-group representative assignment
records.material_pending_reason: Full positive correspondence of the initial southern course and its connection to the named middle river is absent. This is a genuine missing geographic interval, not merely an uncertain hydronym boundary.
records.geographic_disambiguation: The named middle/lower corridor is Rio Maracaçumé, followed north and northeast past Maracaçumé and toward Cândido Mendes into a branching mangrove estuary communicating with the Atlantic. A real material gap remains in the initial southern course and its connection through the Alto Turiaçu/Centro do Guilherme setting. The available2010 maps are sparse there, the Centro Novo original has unread source tiles, and distinct additional source maps were unavailable. The result is source-material-pending, not a completed naming-scope hold.

component_scope_limits: The candidate is supported for the mapped middle/lower Maracaçumé corridor; unresolved initial correspondence prevents a completed representative-system result.

records.completion_scope: Primary original Mazagão municipal cartography was read across the complete selected corridor, including the opening, material turns and junctions, lowland tributary setting, adjacent lake complex, lower channels and actual receiving water. Correspondence is generalized component/corridor interpretation, not a bank, vertex, exact spring, present flow or surveyed mouth-point assertion. The optional unavailable IEPA chapter leaves no material geographic gap in the two successfully read originals.
records.region: Amapá, Brazil; selected Maracá/Maracá-Pucu corridor toward the Amazon Canal do Norte.
records.geographic_disambiguation: Both selected mainstem fragments correspond at ordinary corridor scale to an unnamed northwestern feeder, its connection to the Maracá-Pucu corridor near Varador, the northeast-turning middle reach and Camapi do Maracá joining setting, the Pançudo–Maracá lowland course, and the branched lower Rio Maracá-Pucu opening into Canal do Norte of the Amazon. Rio Maracá-Pucu is supported as a representative system identity. The initial feeder and every side channel are not assigned this scalar name.
records.supported_name_scope: Representative identity of the mapped receiving river and lower estuarine system, without naming the initial feeder, each tributary, side lake, distributary or the receiving Amazon channel after it.

component_scope_limits: The first northwestern feeder is depicted but its hydronym is not established; its name remains null.

Rio Maracá-Pucu is printed on the western/middle receiving river in the 04/2021 map and on the lower river in both original map editions. Rio Maracá is also a bounded mapped label in the middle corridor; a formal universal synonym or exact name-change boundary is not established.
Rio Camapi do Maracá, Igarapé do Repartimento and Igarapé do Pimentel identify the separate northern tributary setting. Their names are not extended to the selected initial feeder.
Lagoa do Maracá and Lago do Maracá labels in the 04/2021 panel occur with locality/community symbols; those labels alone do not establish a selected lake traversal.
The broad waterbody complex beside Poção do Rio Preto is east of the selected lower corridor; the selected route is not renamed Rio Preto or assumed to cross that complex.

The middle retained centerline is a generalized western approximation of parts of the mapped river corridor around the Lagoa do Maracá–Barro Alto lowlands. Exact small-channel selection is not claimed. The mapped river and joining tributaries provide the continuous geographic interpretation at ordinary corridor scale.

Canal do Norte is the mapped receiving Amazon-estuary channel, not a river-system hydronym replacement. The retained terminal class sea is only model metadata; the actual mapped endpoint setting is a river mouth into that channel.
No uniform whole-feature scalar, Korean name, formal registry status or product application is established.

reconstruction_rule: Start from the pinned r46 cumulative index and apply later append-only deltas in verified commit order, rejecting duplicate IDs. publication_boundary: Own factual name/scope findings, public official URLs, bounded geometry metadata and public continuity pins only. No original maps, crops, complete coordinates or private source/derivative/registration fingerprints. Official hosting does not establish source redistribution rights.

research_order.progress_rule: Follow the actual continental order: Americas, Asia, Africa, Europe, then other, with all rivers before lakes. Preserve original queue IDs and ranks for continuity; apply documented geographic deferrals without counting them as name research, and place deferred objects into their corrected later phase by length-descending, stable-ID order. Prior candidate and scope-held assessments remain unresolved where stated.
